source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Load Balancing' (PDF 19): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network load balancing network traffic manage karne (sambhalne) ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh kaam ko kai servers ya links (raaston) mein distribute karti (baant'ti) hai. Is se kisi ek device par overloading (had se zyada bojh) nahi hoti. Load balancing network ki speed aur reliability (bharosa) behtar karti hai. Yeh bare networks aur data centers (hazaron servers wali imaratein) mein istemal hoti hai. Proper (sahi) load balancing smooth performance yaqeeni banati hai. Yeh networks ko zyada users sambhalne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Bank mein teen counter hon aur saare log ek hi counter par khare hon to line lambi hogi. Guard logon ko teeno counters par baant de to sab ka kaam jaldi hoga. Load balancer yahi guard hai.

blocks.prompt: Load balancing kis cheez ko rokti hai?
blocks.explanation: Kisi ek server ya device par had se zyada bojh (overloading) ko.

items: Load balancing: traffic ko kai servers/links mein baantna; overloading nahi; speed, reliability, zyada users.
